_doc: BEARING OFF (d10), Close Action 1997 combat chart (docs/combat_tables_1.jpeg). Crew quality -> maneuver type -> highest d10 roll (0-9) that succeeds: roll <= number succeeds. null = NA (the ship cannot bear off). DRMs (applied by MovementResolver): +1 for 4-6 MPs plotted, +2 for 7+ MPs plotted, +3 rudder destroyed/jammed, +1 poor maneuvering.
